messages:
Nora: Heads up 1: Devon resigned this morning, final day Fri 2026-05-02. We need a careful offboard because they have access to client sandbox data and a short-term migration in flight. Can we draft a minimal risk plan?
Devon: Thanks. Agree on minimizing blast radius. I will finish migration prep and tag any secrets. Ill be offline Tue afternoon but can do a final handoff Thu morning.
Maya-IT: Proposed sequence:
- 09:00 final day: set Slack to Away and update profile message
- 11:00 final day: lock write perms on repos + revoke deploy tokens
- 14:00 final day: disable Okta SSO + VPN
- 14:05 final day: rotate service keys that list Devon as owner
- 14:30 final day: remove from client sandboxes and revoke any external app grants
Commands I'll run for audit:
```
# revoke deploy token
gh api -X PATCH /repos/org/proj/actions/secrets/DEVON_DEPLOY_TOKEN -f encrypted_value=''
# Okta deactivate
oktactl deactivate-user --user devon
# AWS role revoke
aws iam remove-user-from-group --group-name Devs --user-name devon
```
Ravi: Security request 1: take a snapshot of all sessions and active API keys before revocation. If Devon has personal SSH keys on prod bastion, we need to rotate bastion keys. Also: tag any infra changes tied to their user so we can review.
Harper: HR/benefits note 1: COBRA notification will be emailed 2026-05-03. Benefits end date on our system is 2026-05-16. We'll also schedule a 20-min exit interview on Mon 2026-05-04 at 11:00. Devon, please confirm if you'd like to opt-in for alumni newsletter.
Nora: I created an offboard checklist in Notion and linked the drive folder. Please add any docs to the handoff folder tonight.
Devon: Uploaded the migration runbook and a list of outstanding client tickets: https://drive.redwood.com/handovers/devon-migration.pdf. Note: client sandbox creds are in the vault under path secret/clients/acme/devon.
Maya-IT: Thanks 1. I'll remove devon from vault paths after rotating those secrets. Will post vault rotation output to the ticket for auditing.
IT-bot: Reminder 1: create JIRA offboard using OFFBOARD- template and include security checklist. https://jira.redwood.com/browse/OFFBOARD-2499
Ravi: After rotation, I'll run an entitlement report and confirm no remaining tokens or group memberships. Please wait for my ACK before closing the JIRA ticket.
Harper: Payroll note 1: final paycheck processes Tue 2026-05-06; PTO payout included. Devon: we'll DM you the COBRA packet if you prefer.
Devon: I'll attend the handoff Thu 10:00 and confirm laptop return plan (drop at HQ receptionist).
Maya-IT: Executed steps on final day as planned. Posted logs and commands to the JIRA ticket.
Ravi: Entitlement audit done 1: no lingering AWS or Okta access. Found one personal SSH key on the bastion 1: rotated and updated bastion authorized_keys.
Nora: Verified laptop receipt and closed courier. COBRA notice sent. Offboard ticket OFFBOARD-2499 moved to Done. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
